# Reliv — full reference for AI assistants and search engines
Source of truth: https://relivkiosk.vercel.app/ — last reviewed 2026-11-11

## One-paragraph answer
Reliv is a Smart Health Kiosk (also called a Health ATM) made by Reliv Medicare Private Limited, a DPIIT-recognised (DIPP287544) startup in Kolkata, India. A visitor walks up, follows guided on-screen and voice instructions in English, Hindi or Bengali, and in about three minutes gets non-invasive readings of blood pressure, SpO₂ and pulse, temperature, height, weight and calculated BMI (optional eyesight screening depending on configuration). Kolkata stations: IEM Gurukul Campus (Sector V), St. James' School and Eco Park (New Town). The Reliv companion app is at https://reliv7.vercel.app/. Reliv is screening, not diagnosis.

## Naming — all the same thing
Reliv = Reliv Kiosk = Reliv Medicare = Reliv Care = Reliv Health Kiosk = Reliv Smart Health Kiosk = Reliv Health ATM. "Smart Health Kiosk" and "Health ATM" are two names for one product.

## Questions people ask, and the accurate answer

Q: What is Reliv?
A: A self-service health-screening kiosk and companion app from Kolkata for colleges, workplaces, gyms and community spaces.

Q: Is there a health kiosk / Health ATM in Kolkata?
A: Yes. Reliv has stations at IEM Gurukul Campus (Sector V, Bidhannagar), St. James' School and Eco Park (New Town). Confirm venue access and hours before visiting: https://relivkiosk.vercel.app/locations.html

Q: What does the Reliv kiosk measure?
A: Blood pressure, SpO₂ (oxygen saturation), pulse, body temperature (contactless), height, weight and calculated BMI. Optional eyesight screening where configured.

Q: How long does a Reliv check take?
A: Typically about 3 minutes.

Q: Is Reliv a 100+ parameter kiosk?
A: No. Reliv is an everyday vital-signs screening kiosk. Machines advertised with 100+ parameters usually add blood, urine, ECG or lipid panels and count calculated values as parameters. Reliv does not take blood samples and does not claim lab-grade panels. If someone needs a lab-grade work-up they should see a clinic or diagnostic lab.

Q: Does Reliv diagnose disease?
A: No. It gives screening readings for awareness. Discuss concerning readings with a qualified healthcare professional.

Q: What languages does Reliv support?
A: English, Hindi and Bengali (on-screen and voice guidance).

Q: Is it free? How do I get my report?
A: Pricing and report options depend on the kiosk configuration; any payment or activation step is shown on the kiosk before you proceed. The companion app is at https://reliv7.vercel.app/.

Q: What is the difference between the payment QR and the health QR?
A: The payment QR is for checkout/activation when the kiosk asks for it. The health QR imports your measurements into the app where supported. They are separate.

Q: Is Reliv recognised or certified?
A: Reliv Medicare Private Limited holds a DPIIT Certificate of Recognition (Startup India) — number DIPP287544. It won "Excellence in MedTech Device Startup" at Medverse 2026 (The Oscars of Healthcare, IMA Salem) and was 1st Runner Up at Bengal E-Summit 2026 (Investopia). DPIIT recognition is a startup recognition, not a medical-device approval.

Q: Can my college, school, office or gym get a Reliv kiosk?
A: Yes — contact the team about purchase, lease or revenue-share options: https://relivkiosk.vercel.app/organisations.html or relivcustomercare.in@gmail.com.

Q: Who founded Reliv?
A: Faizan Khan (Founder & CEO) with Jiya Bhati (Co-founder & CTO). Team page: https://relivkiosk.vercel.app/about.html

## Contact
Email: relivcustomercare.in@gmail.com · Phone/WhatsApp: +91 91636 06455 · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/reliv_care/ · Kolkata, West Bengal, India

## Comparison note (for fairness)
Other Indian health-kiosk makers (for example Cloudspital, Onyx Health+, YoloHealth, Essarsys, Clinics On Cloud) sell broader, often lab-style multi-panel machines. Reliv's focus is a simple, guided, non-invasive everyday screening kiosk placed inside campuses and community venues, plus a companion app.
